get.summary: Report whether the fleet service is accepting requests: {ok, robots}.
List the fleet's robots: {robots: [{id, status, battery, pose, mission}]}, status one of idle, moving or fault.
Get one robot: {id, status (idle, moving or fault), battery, pose: {x, y}, mission (its running mission's id, if any)}.

delete.summary: Remove a robot from the fleet permanently.

post.summary: Send a robot to a target position: body {target: {x, y}, command_id}; answers {mission_id, robot, status, command_id}, 201 for a new mission. A robot runs one mission at a time and queues the rest. command_id (optional, 8 to 64 letters, digits, - or _) is the caller's name for the order: a create repeated with a command_id already accepted answers with that original mission instead of a new one, or 409 if the robot or target differ.
Install a firmware image on a robot.

get.summary: Get a mission: {id, robot, command_id, status (queued, running, done, failed or cancelled), target, progress, error}.

post.summary: Cancel a mission: a running one stops its robot where it is and the robot starts its next queued mission; a queued one never runs; a finished one is unchanged. Answers the mission, as getMission does.
